title: BLOOM plant art pack metadata (art/plant/packs/<pack>/atlas.json)
description: STRUCTURE only. tools/build-plant-art.mjs additionally enforces everything that needs the PNG or the contract: exact palette colours, alpha 0/255, rects inside the image and non-overlapping, no stray pixels, anchor/points inside the rect and on opaque pixels, metadata == art/plant/contract.json components, every component × angle × side present, and no sprite clipping at any socket. Human contract: docs/PLANT_SPRITE_PIPELINE_v1.md § ARTIST_HANDOFF.

bodyPlan.description: (BLOOM-035B-5) the body plan this pack draws: "<plan>@<version>" of art/plant/body-plans/<plan>.json (oh-stem@1 · rosette@1 · candle@1 · reed@1). Omitted only by a PMO-locked pack listed in a plan's lockedPacks (the Organic Hybrid delivery = oh-stem@1). The pack is validated against THAT plan's contract.

status.description: e.g. "TEMPORARY PIPELINE PROOF — NOT FINAL ART" or "APPROVED <date> <who>"

image.description: the atlas PNG, relative to this folder

swatch.description: optional strip in the PNG showing exactly the declared palette (ignored by the renderer; validated)

palette.description: material → colour ramp, darkest first. ink has 1 colour, every other material 4. Every colour is unique across the pack. Required: ink, leaf, stem, root, core, frost, salt, pod, pigLeaf, pigStem, pigCore, waxLeaf, waxCore.

sky.description: top, bottom of the specimen-box sky

water.description: (BLOOM-035B-5) standing water band, deep and light — required by a body plan on waterlogged ground (reed@1)

stemOutline.description: outline of the PROCEDURAL stem: its own darkest shade, the ink colour, or none (default self)

rect.description: [x, y, w, h] in atlas pixels; x, y = top-left

point.description: [x, y] relative to the sprite rect's top-left pixel

id.description: = component, or component.angle for angled components (leaf.base.mid, leaf.flood.2.heat.high)

component.description: a component id of the pack's body-plan contract (oh-stem: art/plant/contract.json; others: art/plant/contracts/<plan>.json); the build checks it against THAT registry

angle.description: one of the plan's authored angle steps (oh-stem / candle / reed: low · mid · high; rosette: flat · low · mid · high)

anchor.description: the ONE pixel of this sprite that is placed exactly on the socket

order.description: tie-break inside the layer (higher draws later / in front)

mirror.description: right-facing sprites: true = the build bakes the left twin

family.description: frost and salt are separate families (Cold insulation never doubles as Salt crystals)

points.description: leaf sprites: where surface details (frost tufts …) ride on THIS drawing

masks.description: treatment → "auto" (every pixel of a recolourable material; not allowed for the clear-kind 'toothed') or [x, y] = top-left of a mask rect of the sprite's exact size elsewhere in the PNG (opaque = inside). pigment / wax: recolour; toothed: clear (authored notches).
